The region is a 15 km disc round Douma cut to Syria (one cell, 253 km2): the Ghouta page gives the whole oasis as about 20 by 10 km, so one cell is the right order. notes: Written by n-mod from seven pages (two over the budget, to mirror the islamic-state ledger's gains from 'Syrian opposition'). REBEL STATE: Cliopatria has no row; slug named as counterpart by syria (ledger 12, 14, 16, 19, 23, 24) and islamic-state (1, 3, 4, 5, written there as the name 'Syrian opposition'). The islamic-state ledger should re-point its counterpart to this slug. NOT MIRRORED: islamic-state ledger 3 (Jarabulus and al-Bab, 2014) and 4 (al-Hawl, 2014) name this state but no page opened says the rebels held those parcels or when; the Syrian National Army zone from Operation Euphrates Shield (August 2016) and the Daraa and Quneitra south (to 2018), Deir ez-Zor (2012-2014), Homs and Hama pockets and the 2020 Idlib line are not dated on the pages opened and are not drawn. DOUBLE-LOSS WARNING: syria ledger 12 (Raqqa 2013) and 13 (Raqqa and Deir ez-Zor to the Islamic State 2014) both take the same land from Syria, while this dossier gains Raqqa from Syria in March 2013 and loses it to the Islamic State in January 2014; syria ledger 13 should read counterpart syrian-opposition for Raqqa. The syria ledger has no 2012 losses of Aleppo, Manbij or Ghouta; this dossier's 2012 gains are the matching entries. REGION CHOICES: Eastern Ghouta is a 15 km disc round Douma cut to Syria (one cell, 253 km2; the Ghouta page gives the oasis as about 20 by 10 km), replacing the first draft's 'Damascus (region)' (72 cells, 18,209 km2, with Damascus city and cells of Lebanon and Israel), which syria ledger 19 still uses and the syria owner should narrow the same way; Aleppo is Syria's own 25 km disc (7 cells), so the divided city is one contested block. The state ends on 8 December 2024; the transitional government is the syria dossier's continuation (its ledger 25). No capital is entered (the opposition had no seat: coalition offices were abroad and the pages opened name none). REPAIR ROUND (n-mod-fixed, 2026-11-02): Eastern Ghouta redrawn as one cell round Douma; capital Idlib 2017-2024 added; thin parcels added from five more pages (13 pages in all, far over the budget, because the reviewer named the pages): al-Bab 2012-2013, the Rastan pocket 2012-May 2018, Quneitra 2014-2018 and Daraa 2015-2018. Still undrawn: Jarabulus and Azaz (the Al-Bab page does not mention them), rebel Deir ez-Zor 2012-2014, the Idlib countryside before 2015 and the rest of western Aleppo, the Turkish-backed zone. Daraa and Quneitra are drawn whole although the pages give 70 and 80 per cent; Rastan and al-Bab are researcher's discs. None of the new gains and losses has a mirror in the syria ledger.
